# Accessibility cue recordings

These recordings were supplied by Amethyst through the Time Stranger and Ocarina projects
and bundled here at her request. They are not recordings extracted by Shipwright PR 5435.
The manifest records the original files and SHA-256 hashes, and the bundled hashes.

Conversion uses FFmpeg 8.0.1: mono, 32000 Hz, signed 16-bit PCM WAV, without normalization
or pitch changes. Source recordings were left unchanged.

No new copyright or redistribution license is asserted by this notice. Confirm the
recordings' distribution terms before publishing a public package.
